mechanism: Tizanidine is metabolized by CYP1A2, and sacubitril/valsartan may increase hypotensive effects through additive vasodilation and CNS depression via tizanidine's alpha-2 agonist activity.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; consider dose adjustment of tizanidine or alternative muscle relaxant; counsel on orthostatic hypotension risk and CNS depression symptoms.
